تستغفلن (form X)
# تَسْتَغْفِلْنَ (tastaḡfilna) /tas.taɣ.fil.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
# تُسْتَغْفَلْنَ (tustaḡfalna) /tus.taɣ.fal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
